map.不冲突，分别针对不同自由度；平动看线动量、转动看角动量。结果按标准力学公式实时计: They do not conflict, as they address different degrees of freedom: translation uses linear momentum, rotation uses angular momentum. map.爆炸算守恒吗？: Does an explosion count as conserved?
